messages:
sam: Heads-up: seeing stale API key being used by long-lived AsyncClient instances after key rotation. Requests succeed/fail intermittently.
tasha: how are you rotating keys? env var + SIGHUP? or calling SDK method?
sam: env var + a reload endpoint that sets os.environ, then we expect clients to pick up new key.
sam: sample snippet:
```py
# created at app startup
client = AsyncClient(base_url=..., api_key=os.environ.get("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
# background task reuses client
await client.generate(...)
```
sam: when env var updated, new client constructed for web handlers, but background tasks keep using old client instance.
tasha: that's expected if you pass key at init. SDK currently caches header/token at client init for perf.
tasha: short term: explicit client.close() and recreate background client after rotation.
tasha: medium term: we should add an AuthProvider interface so clients pull header on each request (or have a refresh hook).
nish: also saw typing issues in our auth provider PR — AsyncClient currently typed to accept Union[str, Callable[[], str]] but runtime expects Callable[[], Awaitable[str]] for async reload. mismatch causes silent fallback to str.
nish: reproduced in tests, opened PR to adjust typing and impl: https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-sdk/pull/842
sam: thanks. workaround for now: create a thin wrapper that returns awaitable:
```py
async def key_provider():
    return os.environ["REDWOOD_API_KEY"]
# note: current SDK may not await this; see PR
client = AsyncClient(api_key=key_provider)
```
tasha: hmm that won't work until PR merged. So add a helper in app:
```py
async def get_client():
    return AsyncClient(api_key=await key_provider())
```
ops-bot: can we add a small migration note in changelog and docs? :memo:
tasha: yes, I'll add a short note in auth docs and add a section on rotation patterns + examples.
sam: filing a follow-up issue for "client: support async auth provider and hot-reload" — #1876
nish: adding a test to catch regressions, will include typing stubs
sam: great. if anyone on call wants to pair on the small fix I'm free this afternoon.
tasha: :thumbsup:
